summary: Stopped at the ticket's own precondition: an axis already doing most of this is in flight. PR #67 rewrites exactly the two files this proposal names, already gives this very predicate a cause string, and already replaces the flat 'Invalid class file' at both boundary sites. Doing it now on main would be a third competing edit to the same enum and would rediscover the same duplicated boundary. The proposal's residue after #67 is real but narrower than the proposal describes, and it is recorded as a new, correctly scoped card.
changes: no code: classfile/src/error.rs and classfile/src/validation.rs untouched
docs/worklog only — the finding, the measurements, and a narrowed successor proposal
verification: PREMISE CONFIRMED on main @ 8c7b473f, measured by running the CLI rather than by reading: three different rules all print the identical message. `rust_java -cp ./test-data/ldc LdcDynamicBSMArgPastEnd` (bad bootstrap argument), `LdcDynamicDuplicateBSM` (duplicate attribute) and `LdcDynamicOldMajor` (version gate) each answer `java.lang.ClassFormatError: Invalid class file`

OVERLAP, split into the two axes it was conflating. By EDIT AREA it is total: this proposal's target is classfile/src/error.rs and classfile/src/validation.rs, and PR #67 changes exactly those two (error.rs 10/1, validation.rs 61/27 against their merge base), already gives this predicate the cause 'a bootstrap method argument names nothing or is not a loadable constant', and already rewrites both boundary sites that hardcode 'Invalid class file'. By DELIVERED CAPABILITY — which is what precondition (c) actually asks — it is 1 of 3: the proposal wants expected, index and actual, and #67's &'static str payload supplies the expectation only. An earlier draft wrote 'OVERLAP IS TOTAL' unqualified, which contradicted the residue entry three lines down and is the same word that produced the under-sized effort on the card.

CONTRACT 2 SWEEP: the literal 'Invalid class file' is hardcoded at two boundary sites, src/runtime.rs:189 and test-utils/src/lib.rs:334. #67 rewrites both; a round starting from main would have to change both again and would hit the same test-coverage gap #67's round already reported

RESIDUE IS REAL BUT NARROWER: #67's payload is &'static str, which structurally cannot carry a runtime index. So after #67 lands the proposal's 'expected' is delivered by the rule wording and its 'index' and 'actual' are not

DESIGN CONSTRAINT the proposal does not name: ClassFileError derives Copy. Carrying an owned String would drop Copy for every consumer. Counted at 8c7b473f with git grep -c: classfile/tests/test.rs 13, classfile/src/validation.rs 8, classfile/src/class.rs 7, jvm-bytecode/src/error.rs 5 — that is 4 FILES across 2 CRATES (classfile three, jvm-bytecode one), not four crates as an earlier draft said; the two further hits under tests/ are comments, not code. A Copy-preserving shape exists — the static cause plus a u16 index plus the u8 tag found — so the successor does not need to break it.

issues: Not stacking on #67's branch was a choice, not an oversight: #67 is not approved (its gate2 re-review is in flight), its head moves each round, and a PR based on it would be a child PR whose base can vanish on merge — the hazard gate3 contract 5 exists for.
This leaves the flat message in place on main until #67 lands. That is the cost of not duplicating: a user bisecting a rejected class file today still gets no cause at all, not even the rule.

proposals.title: Add a structured variant that names the failing bootstrap argument's index and tag
proposals.plainSummary: Once the rejection says which rule failed, give that one rule a richer error that also carries which argument number was wrong and what it actually pointed at.
proposals.userBenefit: OpenJDK says 'argument_index 4 has bad constant type'. Naming the rule gets a reader to the right sentence; naming the index and the tag gets them to the right byte without bisecting the file.
proposals.why: This is the measured residue of 2026-09-17-loadable-bootstrap-arguments#p0 after PR #67. That PR carries the cause as a &'static str, which cannot hold a runtime index, so of the proposal's three asks — expected, index, actual — it delivers the first and not the other two. The predicate already knows the index at the moment it returns false and throws it away.
proposals.tradeoff: Measured rather than estimated, against #67's tree. Widening InvalidFormat's payload would touch 17 construction sites (validation.rs 14, class.rs 3) and force all 11 value matches in classfile/tests/test.rs to change. Adding a separate variant instead touches one construction site and forces none of the 11, so that is the shape proposed — but it leaves TWO KINDS of rejection error side by side, and 'why is this one structured and that one a bare string' becomes a standing question every later rule has to answer. Either way the work crosses the same three layers, because the middle layer (jvm-bytecode ClassDefinitionError::InvalidClassFile) is also &'static str and the boundary (jvm exception(&str)) takes a plain string, so the text has to be formatted at src/runtime.rs and test-utils/src/lib.rs. ClassFileError also derives Copy and 4 files across 2 crates use it, so the payload must stay Copy: static cause plus u16 index plus u8 tag. And it must be sequenced after #67, not beside it — both touch the same enum and function.
